clarification.message: ClinicalTrials.gov cannot answer which treatment is safest, best or right for someone. Registry records report outcomes and adverse events trial by trial, for different patients, doses and follow-up times, so ranking drugs from them would be misleading, and no single number in the registry measures 'safety'. A doctor can weigh that evidence for a specific person. I can show what the registry does record instead.
